name: Literature Research System
description: Read alphaXiv bookmarks, deduplicate and archive in Zotero, sync linked PDFs through Google Drive, and continue research in the installed OpenResearch app inside RN.
description_zh: 读取 alphaXiv 收藏，去重归档到 Zotero，通过 Google Drive 同步链接 PDF，在 RN 内打开本地 OpenResearch 继续研究。

flows.purpose: Read bookmarked public arXiv papers and deduplicate stable identifiers.
Archive metadata, source notes, and linked PDF attachments.
Save verified PDF files in the user-selected local sync folder.
Google Drive for desktop synchronizes files using the user's own login.
Open both installed tools inside RN; choose a paper and provide its link or file to a research conversation.
